about.title: About
about: Hello, my name is Thomás D'Angelo de Almeida Gomes, but you can call me Thom. I'm a front-end developer and university student. I'm a curious, dedicated person, always seeking to learn something new.

From an early age, I've always been interested in games. Playing was my favorite pastime with my older brother, but beyond just playing, I was very curious about how games worked and whether we could create games someday. With this interest, I started working with RPG Maker, which gave me a foundation on how the pieces fit together.
So from then on, whenever someone asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up, I would answer 'I want to work with technology'.

During the pandemic, I started a technical course in Systems Analysis and Development, where I had contact with various programming languages and technologies. It was during this period that I decided to deepen my knowledge in front-end development. Whenever I had an academic project, I was responsible for the design and programming.
After my technical course, I started taking on small freelance projects, which was great for me. While I was studying, I could work and see how various other things worked within a project.

At the beginning of 2024, I started my degree in Systems Analysis and Development at Uninassau, where I met incredible people (and some not so much, but that's part of life). From now on, I intend to keep improving more and more.

list.title: Fynli
description: Fynli is a comprehensive web application built to solve a real problem: the mess of managing personal and family expenses in a single account.

The project was developed end-to-end, with a focus on data security, performance, and a reactive user experience. Using React and Next.js on the frontend, TypeScript for static typing, Tailwind CSS and Shadcn for a modern and responsive design.

On the backend, Supabase was chosen to handle authentication and SQL database management, ensuring scalability and security. Fynli offers an intuitive interface so users can efficiently track their finances.
Fynli is more than a simple expense manager; it's a solution designed to make users' financial lives easier.
